original_benchmark.notes: VitaBench (meituan-longcat/vitabench, ICLR 2026), English task set. Four task sets of 100 tasks each: delivery, instore, ota (single-scenario) and cross_domain (cross-scenario, the paper's headline split). Simulated-user conversation over a 66-tool environment; rubric-based sliding-window LLM evaluator; binary per-task reward.

harbor_adapter.notes: Each task runs the original VitaBench environment and user simulator in an MCP sidecar (vita-runtime); the verifier replays the recorded conversation through the official vita.evaluator. Oracle solutions are stored, pre-validated trajectories (the benchmark ships no reference solutions). Parity pending.
